tools.name: audit_code_snippet
tools.description: Audit source files for circular dependencies (Tarjan SCC), coupling metrics (Ca/Ce/I), and 12 production reliability/security/SOLID anti-patterns (N+1 loops, missing HTTP timeouts, unbounded caches, check-then-act races, missing idempotency keys, SQL/command injection). Returns health score + Mermai

tools.name: check_migration_safety
tools.description: Audit PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite DDL migrations for production table locks and rolling-deploy breaks, generating a 3-phase Expand-Contract plan.

tools.name: estimate_system_capacity
tools.description: Compute exact distributed systems capacity math: avg/peak QPS, storage, bandwidth Gbps, Redis RAM, shard count & bottleneck, Little's Law concurrency. Supports Big Tech presets or custom inputs.

tools.name: simulate_quorum_and_tail_latency
tools.description: Verify Dynamo quorum (W+R>N), Raft fault tolerance, and Jeff Dean fanout tail-latency amplification (1-(1-p)^K) with hedged RPC comparison.

tools.name: simulate_consistent_hashing
tools.description: Run deterministic FNV-1a+fmix32 consistent hashing ring simulation measuring load skew & scale-out key remapping % vs modulo hashing.

tools.name: recommend_architecture
tools.description: Generate a Staff-level distributed system architecture blueprint from workload traits (consistency, R/W ratio, contention, real-time need, latency SLO).
